errors.evidence: The chart is a vertical bar chart, where bars extend upwards from the horizontal axis, not a horizontal bar chart.

errors.text_span: Die Balkenhöhe sinkt im Allgemeinen in den späteren Jahren
errors.evidence: This is an oversimplification of the trend. While the values decrease from the peak in 2010 to a low in 2019, they rise again in 2020 and 2021 before declining slightly. It is not a general decrease in later years.

errors.text_span: mit dem niedrigsten Wert im Jahr 2024 bei etwa 62,9
errors.evidence: This statement is incorrect in two ways. First, the value 62.9 corresponds to the year 2023, not 2024. Second, the lowest value shown in the chart is for the year 2019 (58.7), not 2024.

errors.text_span: Der Wert jedes Jahres ist direkt über jedem Balken angegeben.
errors.evidence: This is incorrect. Only four specific years have their values labeled on the chart: 2010 (81.0), 2019 (58.7), 2021 (68.1), and 2023 (62.9).

errors.text_span: Alle Balken sind einheitlich hellblau gehalten
errors.evidence: The bars for the years 2023 and 2024 are a noticeably lighter shade of blue than the bars for the preceding years, so they are not uniform in color.
The description omits the prominent horizontal black line drawn across the chart at the y-value of 60, which serves as a key reference point.
